## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes (format, lint, tests with and without HA, coverage, audit, schema, example config, fleetlint)
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests; a new adapter passes its port's contract suite
- [ ] Docs and `stellwerk.example.yaml` are updated if user-facing behavior changed (`make schema` after config changes)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has an entry under the next version
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are signed off (`git commit -s`)
